item.title: Thanksgiving storm damages buildings, floods streets, causes power outages
item.description: Strong winds ripped the roof off a building in Maryland, as an extreme storm began to move up the East Coast on Thanksgiving morning.

item.title: Zelenskyy urges the US to pressure Putin, calling Trump’s 'my friend' remark strange

item.title: Trump says he's giving Iran "a chance to be smart"
item.description: Trump says victory over Iran will come "whenever I want it," but he's giving the regime "a chance to be smart" while his threat of new strikes looms.
